title: zesty light turkish barramundi su-boregi
description: a light and zesty turkish dish featuring barramundi, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: cut the barramundi into small pieces and season with salt, black pepper, and turkish red pepper flakes.
mix together the flour and a pinch of salt in a shallow dish.
dip each piece of barramundi into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
heat the infuse-oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add the coated barramundi to the skillet and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
transfer the barramundi to a baking dish and sprinkle with feta cheese, dried parsley, and lemon juice.
unroll the filo dough and cut it into small squares.
place a piece of filo dough on top of each piece of barramundi, pressing the edges to seal.
drizzle the top of each su-boregi with a little more infuse-oil and sprinkle with garlic.
bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the filo dough is golden brown and crispy.
